items.text:
Friendship Bracelet
          Gain 1 Guard at the start of every turn for each Keepsake you carry.

Spare Key
          Curiosities show you one extra way through. The locked option is never locked to you.

Night Vendor's Lantern
          Mr. Moth's always has one Rare Trick on the table, and everything costs 10% less.

Bathhouse Slippers
          Your first Trick each turn ignores any increase to its Nerve cost.

Bent Garden Fork
          The first time each Scuffle an enemy recovers Courage, deal 3 damage to it.
